race.comment: MYTHOLOGY (10) has a handy record over this distance range with a win and a placing from just two attempts and will strip fitter third-up from the spell. Drawn to get all the favours from the inside alley and gets the reliable Gollan/Cartwright combination. Plenty of upside and should be right there at the business end. SMASHING NOVA (3) hasn't been too far away in recent outings and looks to be working up to another victory. Strong top-three prospects on best figures. WELCOME ADVICE (14) returned in fine fashion with a strong Doomben win and will have come on with that run now under the belt. Don't dismiss lightly. ARTISTIC ENDEAVOUR (1) knuckled down strongly when finished a nose from the winner here. Should be winding up late again.
